messages:
Lucas: Morning team — kicking off StratusEdge eu-southwest region onboarding. Partner wants soft-launch with Dedicated pools + marketplace private SKU. Target launch 2026-06-15. Flag obvious blockers?
Mateo: Partner update: contract signed, they've requested both A100 fallback and T4 baseline. Initial ask: 24 x A100 (on-demand) OR 88 x T4-equivalent. They prefer regional A100 capacity for lower-latency inference.
Eve: From cloud-ops: A100 quota in eu-southwest is constrained. We can probably approve 8 A100s immediately; full 24 will need capacity gating and quota justification. I'll open a quota ticket.
infra-bot: quota-bot: new ticket SE-7090 created, status: pending review. Include throughput justification to speed up.
Lucas: Mateo, can you get the partner to accept a staged pool: start with 8 A100 + 48 T4s, then scale to target after quota approval? That would let us run canaries.
Mateo: Will ask. They want a clear path to scale. Also they need KMS BYOK with HSM wraps and egress controls for EU customer data.
Sofia: Compliance: must have DPA addendum signed and data flow diagram showing where keys live. If BYOK, we need key rotation policy and attestations. Also export-control review for A100 usage (some partners flagged in previous onboards).
Lucas: Noted. Theo, partner asked about joint announcement/marketing timing. They want PR day aligned with marketplace GA.
Theo: For PR we need embargo date and final marketplace copy 7 business days prior. Also need logo assets and an approved quote from partner legal. Recommend we aim for a soft-announce internally 3 days before public.
Eve: Quota ticket SE-7090 — include this block so infra can auto-approve faster:
```
project: redwood-eu-prod
region: eu-southwest
resource: nvidia-a100
quota: 24
justification: "StratusEdge Dedicated pools for low-latency inference; initial staged rollout."
```
Lucas: Also need marketplace private SKU metadata: billing code, entitlement flag, and whether partner wants usage metering via our billing connector or partner-managed billing.
Mateo: Partner prefers Redwood billing connector for unified invoicing. Legal to confirm revenue share clause.
Sofia: Add: we require a security questionnaire and third-party penetration test report (past 12 months) before HSM keys are enabled.
infra-bot: policy-bot: reminder — any BYOK request triggers a security gating flow (ticket SE-7091 created).
Eve: Timeline proposal: 1) Quota submit today (SE-7090), 2) Compliance docs & pen-test by partner within 7 days, 3) Marketplace draft to legal in 5 days, 4) Provision staged infra within 72h of partial quota approval. Target go/no-go decision 2026-06-01.
Theo: If go-ahead by 6/1, marketing can prep PR assets and embargo for 6/12 public launch. Internal announce on 6/09.
Lucas: Blockers summary: A) A100 quota shortfall, B) BYOK + pen-test, C) Marketplace legal signoff, D) Billing connector mapping.
Mateo: Partner will try to frontload pen-test and SOC docs this week. I'll update SE-7090 with contact for partner infra.
Sofia: I'll start the dataflow review and send a DPA template.
Eve: I'll attach recommended quota payload and ETA notes to SE-7090. Tagging SRE for runbook and oncall SLA discussion.
Lucas: Great. Next steps: Mateo -> partner docs, Eve -> quota ticket follow-up, Sofia -> DPA & security gating, Theo -> PR timeline draft. Check-in sync Friday 09:30 CET.
Mateo: Logged. I'll confirm staged node numbers after partner call.
Theo: I'll draft embargo schedule and share assets checklist.
infra-bot: reminder-bot: please attach SE-7090 to the region rollout playbook after approval.
